name: InstaBox Cloud Sandboxes
free_limit: Free plan includes one hosted Linux microVM sandbox (4 vCPUs, 8 GiB RAM, 20 GiB persistent disk), five snapshots and 100 GiB outbound transfer per month; free machine runtime is subject to automatic idle pause and maximum-run limits.
watch_out: Official homepage/pricing page still advertises five free machines, but current account pricing and limits documentation specifies ONE; five was a grandfathered beta allowance ending 2026-12-01. Free machines auto-pause when idle and have maximum continuous runtime restrictions, so this is not an always-on VPS. Paid tiers and extra resources are billed; verify account limits, card requirements and commercial-use terms before production use.
